title: Recipe approved
summary: The minted-token entry right after Approve with passkey: the drawer has closed, a success toast confirms, the entry reads Approved and minting has resumed.
compare: The drawer closes on success; the toast says exactly what happened: "Approved. DJDL can mint applemusic.token again." (the lifetime is on the page).
The card head shows Approved as status text with a tick (a healthy state is never a pill); the Catalog nav's warning count and the entry's triangle are gone, and the nav shows 23 again.
The callout is gone; Lifetime keeps 12 hours with no change marker, and Approval history says when and by whom (Ana Lima approved, Today at 16:58); the card head has no sub-line.
There is no approve button anywhere; Approval history stays in the card head.
What DJDL receives shows a token minted now, labelled 'applemusic.token · decoded preview' in the code head; no hint line.

Config's gold accent is never the only cue: a selected Type card is a strong neutral border plus the tick, the open entry is a neutral fill with a neutral edge, and every warning callout has a solid warning rail and a triangle, so selected, changed and needs-approval read differently in both themes.
Spacing and copy pass (2026-10-08): the screen sets no spacing of its own (kit primitives only), and each fact shows once, where it's most useful.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.
Masthead mark (lead answer 3): Catalog's read and Edit states carry the Managed config tile from 1024px (the chip hides there); the h1 stays the record step.

findings.issue: The toast covered the footer text.
findings.resolution: Toast is bottom-centre with 24px clearance (.kit-cfg .toasts) and the page reserves 96px (.toast-clear); the editor behind uses the three-column composition and rail.
